{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 762''' was an isolated [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] in [[The Facility]] section of [[Vergesso Base]].<Ref name="raid">{{WEGCite|story=Slave Raid|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Although there were no major [[slavery/Legends|slave]] markets in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]],<Ref name="raid" /> [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] (the actual owners of Vergesso) used the asteroid as transfer point; to maintain secrecy, the slaves were drugged and sealed in [[holding pod]]s.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
